role: constructive representation of saved physically feasible actions by independent unit targets
registration_context: original shared-target continuum is infeasible at all 23 selected reference states; unit-specific inverse-target reconstruction outcomes unobserved

roster.dependence: overlapping reference histories at the same nomination event

construction.state_and_pending: retain actual stocks and both pending nominations at each existing reference snapshot
construction.desired_new_action: third half-hour nomination from the same already replayed recoverability witness; do not solve for another witness
construction.planning_terms: unchanged received-only V3 terms at the original decision time
construction.projected_stock: actual stock plus received forced inventory change over 90 minutes plus both pending inventory rates times their respective known idle hours
construction.inverse_target: for each unit, target fraction equals (projected stock + desired new inventory rate times known new-slot idle hours) divided by its original capacity
construction.fraction_domain: clip the inverse fraction to the fixed [0,1] domain; the forward reconstruction decides representability, including clipping plateaus
construction.forward_test: call the unchanged nominate_units with each unit's reconstructed target and preserve both individual power clipping and shared gross-power normalization
construction.no_search: one deterministic inverse construction per saved witness; no grid, profile generation, parameter tuning, alternative witness or new LP

analysis.representation: record both raw and clipped target fractions and new-action residual; represented only if original forward-rule deviation is at most the unchanged 1e-8 MW tolerance
analysis.reuse_physical_evidence: reuse the corresponding saved replayed_feasible suffix report and schedule; store references instead of duplicating schedules or rerunning their LPs and replays
analysis.failure: a failed reconstruction is one saved witness not represented by this construction, not proof that the independent-target action family is infeasible

decision: if all saved actions are represented, register a causal unit-specific controller and its candidate mapping before any development rollout; otherwise identify the actual clipping or target-domain obstruction before choosing a revision. Keep the full source-comparison gate HOLD
limitations: target fractions are reconstructed from perfect-information witnesses, so they are not online decisions; representation does not demonstrate a shared causal policy, complete candidate rollout, source benefit or independent confirmation
